s.how: Melt 150g dark chocolate in short bursts in the microwave. Dip 500g dry strawberries halfway, lay on baking paper and chill for 20 minutes until set.

s.note: Reed's flower shop on the busiest day of the year
s.how: Cut 8 slices of bread into hearts and toast until golden. Spread with 150g goat's cheese, drizzle with honey and scatter with thyme leaves. Serve straight away on a big platter in the middle of the table.

m.how: Roast 800g halved potatoes at 220C for 40 minutes. Sear 4 scotch fillets for 3 minutes a side, add 40g butter and crushed garlic and spoon over. Rest and serve with 150g rocket.

w.how: Mix 200g self-raising flour, 2 tbsp cocoa, 150g sugar, 2 eggs, 125ml buttermilk, 100ml oil and red colouring. Bake 12 cupcakes at 180C for 20 minutes. Ice with 250g cream cheese beaten with 150g icing sugar.

d.how: Chill 750ml sparkling rosé and pour into flutes with a raspberry in each. Have 1.25L pink lemonade over ice for anyone not drinking. Make it just before the film starts and keep the jug cold.
